procedures.name: Freedom of Information (FOI) Request
procedures.statute: Freedom of Information Act 2011, Section 2(3) and Section 3
mandatoryFields: Clear description of document or record requested
procedures.guidance: Public institutions are legally required to grant access or state lawful grounds of refusal within 7 working days. No fee may be charged for inspection of public records.

procedures.name: Public Infrastructure Non-Delivery Petition
procedures.guidance: Petitions trigger an on-site joint verification by the agency's monitoring team and the contractor within 15 business days.
